case: 2001 EP-3 crisis: bounded reconstruction and source-access audit
publication_policy: Original analysis, metadata and brief necessary quotations only in Git; full captures and extracts outside Git.
source_independence: Document count is not independent-witness count. MFA items share a publicity chain; White House letter and briefing are related; mirror is a reproduction. Archival administrative records form one institutional chain.
access_policy: Two State archive URLs returned identical Technical Difficulties HTML despite HTTP 200; excluded from the source count. The DoD mirror download returned HTTP 406, the initial Gries PDF request returned HTTP 403, and the full US-government Chinese translation returned HTTP 406. DoD and Gries reading uses preserved browser text. During case reconstruction, the Gries PDF was recovered from the author’s Berkeley laboratory. Relevant Jost article sections were read through the MUSE browser, but the local HTML download is a verification page and excluded as a source capture. The Jost appendix and Dell’Orto’s 21-page memorandum are valid preserved PDFs. The CIA link redirected to the reading-room homepage. Additional State links for Powell’s April 3 and Boucher’s April 10 briefings returned technical-error pages.

sources.title: The Institutional Origins of Miscalculation in China’s International Crises
sources.creator: Tyler Jost
sources.source_type: peer-reviewed scholarly article using original interviews and archival/publication sources
sources.reading_status: Selected theory and methods prose on pp. 47–63, the full reform-period/EP-3 and alternative-explanation discussion on pp. 80–88, and relevant notes 142–190 read through the browser; not the whole 44-page article. Image-only main tables were not visually verified.
sources.locators: International Security 48(1), pp. 47–90; DOI 10.1162/isec_a_00464; EP-3 discussion pp. 82–86, notes 157–183; MUSE browser lines 271–323 and notes at lines 570–650.
sources.source_chain: Author’s mixed-source synthesis; key EP-3 claims combine State cables, Chinese memoirs/biography, later scholarship and coded interviews; underlying Chinese private records not independently acquired in this project
sources.interpretation_limits: Reading is selected, not complete. The internal Chinese information-flow mechanism is a scholarly inference requiring underlying-source checks. The description on p. 83 names a Powell-to-Qian letter, while note 167 describes the two expressions and clearance language found in the released Prueher-to-Tang instrument (EP303). This appears to misidentify the instrument whose wording is described; the letters must be disentangled. It does not establish that no separate Powell–Qian correspondence existed or refute the institutional hypothesis. The April 17 CIA assessment cannot date an earlier decision without its underlying chronology.

sources.title: EP-3 Incident -- Guidance on Legal Issues, with four enclosure groups
sources.creator: Daniel J. Dell’Orto, Acting General Counsel, Department of Defense; DoD/Chairman’s legal offices in consultation with State Legal Adviser
sources.publication_date: Original memorandum dated 2001-04-06; National Security Archive publication dated 2020-10-16; exact FOIA production date not established
sources.event_date_or_period: 2001-04-06; cover says papers developed that week
sources.source_type: contemporaneous internal US legal-guidance memorandum, talking points and press-guidance enclosures, later released under FOIA
sources.reading_status: All 21 physical pages visually read by the delegated researcher; case author independently checked physical pp. 1, 2, 14 and 18. The source has no usable OCR text layer.
sources.locators: Physical p. 1 / 11-L-0559/OSD/1809: cover; pp. 2–3 / OSD/1810–1811: talking points; pp. 4–8 / OSD/1812–1816: legal outline; pp. 9–14 / OSD/1817–1822: aircraft-immunity guidance and clearances; pp. 15–18 / OSD/1823–1826: sovereignty/emergency guidance; pp. 19–21 / OSD/1827–1829: law-of-sea guidance.
sources.source_chain: US government original scan reproduced by the National Security Archive, Briefing Book 726, document 6. The Archive identifies a DoD FOIA-lawsuit release; this is distinct from Bush Library release 2017-0023-F.
sources.interpretation_limits: One explicit (b)(6) excision appears on physical p. 3; copier blemishes limit exact transcription. The cover is informational; guidance clearances do not establish final letter authorization. No intermediate Prueher-letter drafts or Chinese reception are included. Separate legal analyses do not themselves propose crew-first release; the talking points demand immediate aircraft release. Legal views and factual predicates are attributed US positions, not adjudicated findings.

review_status: Initial access audit independently reviewed; subsequent case received a bounded root review on 2026-09-15. Root independently inspected Dell’Orto physical pages 1, 2, 3, 9, 14 and 18, the complete released letter, and Jost’s selected EP-3 discussion and source notes. Refined descriptive versus causal claims, preserved the asymmetric component of S-P25, and identified the Jost letter-attribution discrepancy. This is not an independent complete rereading of all 21 sources.
